extension.summary: Launch websites in Firefox or Google Chrome
extension.description: Launch websites in Firefox or Google Chrome with optional kiosk mode, a custom browser path and a dedicated browser profile.
extension.news:
1.3.0 - Added Firefox support and made it the default browser. - Kept Google Chrome available as a browser option. - Updated the add-on display name.
1.2.0 - Ported to Kodi 21 and Python 3. - Migrated settings and translations to current Kodi formats. - Improved URL handling and safe browser process launching.
